name: JPEX Entertainment Exhibition
blurb: Dubai exhibition celebrating Japanese pop culture with anime, voice actor appearances, cosplay and collectibles.
notes: 2nd edition ran Aug 20-23, 2026 at DWTC Hall 6, audience public, organised by Meas Events (confirmed via the DWTC event listing's JSON-LD and page text). The official site jpex.me now shows a post-event 'JPEX 2026 Thank You! / Share Your Feedback' banner alongside leftover pre-event '2025 Event Highlights... going bigger for JPEX 2026, stay tuned' gallery copy; no 2027 (or later 2026) dates are announced anywhere, so no upcoming edition is listed. Not to be confused with jpex.com (a crypto exchange) or JPEX surveys.
